item.title: Watch President Bostic's Remarks at <cite>Birmingham Business Journal</cite> Event
item.description: On February 20, Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic participated in a moderated conversation with Birmingham Business Journal editor-in-chief Stephanie Rebman.

item.title: President Bostic Speaks at the <cite>Farm Journal</cite>'s Top Producer Summit
item.description: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic discusses the economic factors shaping monetary policy, their potential implications for agriculture, and more during an appearance at the Top Producer Summit in Nashville, Tennessee.

item.title: President Bostic Speaks at Clark Atlanta University
item.description: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic participates in a moderated conversation with Silvanus Udoka, dean of Clark Atlanta University's School of Business, as part of the university's Executive Insights series.

item.title: President Bostic Speaks at the Rotary Club of Atlanta
item.description: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic shares his economic viewpoint during a moderated discussion and Q&A with former Bank president Dennis Lockhart.

item.title: Weighing the Risks: Why Inflation Tips the Scales
item.description: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic delivers remarks and engages in a live Q&A session with attendees at the Atlanta Economics Club.

item.title: The Dual Mandate and the Primacy of Inflation Expectations
item.description: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic speaks at the Institute for Monetary and Financial Stability in Frankfurt, Germany.

item.title: On the State of the US Economy and Monetary Policy
item.description: In a speech to the European Economics and Financial Centre, Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic explains why he voted for a half percentage point reduction in the federal funds rate target at the September 2024 Federal Open Market Committee meeting.

item.title: Never Walk Where a Dance Will Do
item.description: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic tells Augusta Technical College graduates at their commencement that they represent the connective tissue of our economy and society because without people with their skills and talents, our economy will be less prosperous, less competitive, and our overall standard of living will suffer. Watch the video and read the speech.

item.title: Housing's Fundamental Role in Economic Inclusion
item.description: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic spoke at the Confronting America's Housing Crisis conference hosted by Tulane University's Murphy Institute about how the quest to making safe and affordable housing available faces urgent challenges.

item.title: Grateful but Vigilant: New Perspectives for a New Policy Environment
item.description: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic speaks to the Money Marketeers of New York University about how he is formulating his view of the appropriate path of monetary policy.

item.title: Opening Remarks: Uneven Outcomes in the Labor Market
item.description: President Raphael Bostic gives the opening remarks at the Uneven Outcomes in the Labor Market Conference on February 5.

item.title: The Arc of Monetary Policy May Start Bending Soon
item.description: Atlanta Fed president Raphael Bostic discusses his latest thoughts on the macroeconomy and monetary policy at the Atlanta Business Chronicle's 2024 Economic Outlook event.

item.title: Work and Wealth Inequality: Policy Responses and Causes
item.description: Atlanta Fed president Raphael Bostic discusses the role of monetary policy in confronting economic disparities for the New School's Schwartz Lecture. Read the speech and watch the video.

item.title: The Major Challenges in US Monetary Policy
item.description: Atlanta Fed president Raphael Bostic is speaking on August 31 at the South African Reserve Bank Biennial Conference. Watch the video.

item.title: Inflation Should Continue to Fall as Restrictive Policy Bites
item.description: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic spoke in Dublin to the Irish Association of Investment Managers on the fight to bring down inflation.
